list.name: zaehler

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("time", $__interval), statistic_id AS metric, avg(mean) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT statistic_id, "time", mean FROM fuenf_minuten
  WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz <= interval '7 days'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT statistic_id, "time", mean FROM stunde
  WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '7 days'
) x
WHERE statistic_id IN ($sensor)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT tag AS "time", statistic_id AS metric, verbrauch AS value FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', "time", 'Europe/Berlin') AS tag, statistic_id,
    max(sum) - lag(max(sum)) OVER (PARTITION BY statistic_id ORDER BY date_trunc('day', "time", 'Europe/Berlin')) AS verbrauch
  FROM stunde
  WHERE statistic_id IN ($zaehler)
    AND "time" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '1 day' AND "time" < $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) d
WHERE $__timeFilter(tag) AND verbrauch IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1
